digest.component_or_area: llm model-class config schema and resolver
propositions: rebar cannot express which model serves which capability tier because cfg.model is a single scalar, so per-pass model decisions are inferred.

Add three config slots (trivial, standard, frontier) each accepting model, provider, endpoint, and an optional fallback array, parsed from the existing layered config precedence (CLI > env > config file > default).
Expose a resolver mapping class name to a provider-qualified model string, reusing infer_provider when provider is omitted so bare model ids keep resolving as today.
Unset slots default to today's values (frontier=claude-opus-4-8, standard=claude-sonnet-4-6, trivial=claude-haiku-4-5), preserving byte-identical behaviour and serving as the rollback story.
A slot or fallback entry containing api_key must be rejected loudly since secrets are env-only, and a nested fallback must raise a typed config error because the schema is non-recursive.
The fallback array is parsed and validated and carried on the resolved record but not consumed at runtime (deferred to sibling task cc33), and fallback=[] equals an absent fallback key.
